seed: Ask on a blank canvas at Next defaults, with no search key in Settings: 'look up the Meadow design system's base components and make a sheet of them'. Ask says in one short line that searching isn't set up, nothing is searched, opened or made, and the canvas is as it was. Needs a model Ask plans with (Ask finds its model before it reads the request). The lookup itself is proven by the eval's lookup-kit and lookup-injection cases, which serve a search stand-in on loopback.

steps.text: look up the Meadow design system's base components and make a sheet of them

steps.note: Ask says searching isn't set up, and its trace shows no web request
